title: Union Find / DSU
definition: Union-Find manages collection of disjoint sets, supporting union and find operations.
intuition: Keep track of connected components dynamically.
how_it_works: Find determines set membership. Union merges two sets. Optimizations include path compression and union by rank.
when_to_use: Kruskal's MST, detecting cycles in undirected graphs, connected components.
when_not_to_use: When graphs are directed or require edge deletions.
common_mistakes: Merging elements directly instead of representative roots
content: Union-Find manages collection of disjoint sets, supporting union and find operations.
